The library itself spawns nothing." and "The mutexes are global objects in `library/threading.c` with `MUTEX_INIT`" | WHY: The answer says the library spawns no threads and that `library/threading.c` supplies the mutex layer, which many library modules use through `mbedtls_mutex_lock`. || QUOTE: "The library itself spawns nothing." and "The mutexes are global objects in `library/threading.c` with `MUTEX_INIT`" | WHY: The answer states that the library spawns no threads (only sample programs do) and that library/threading.c supplies the mutex abstraction (`mbedtls_mutex_lock`, global mutexes) used when threading is enabled.
